name: Remote Work Expansion
description: Expand hybrid work options to improve hiring and flexibility.
primary_benefit: The company can attract and retain employees while reducing commute-related stress.

name: AI Customer Support Pilot
description: Pilot an AI assistant to help answer routine customer questions.
primary_benefit: Support teams can respond faster to simple requests while freeing staff for higher-value issues.

name: Four-Day Workweek Trial
description: Test a four-day workweek to improve focus and employee well-being.
primary_benefit: Employees may have more focused work time and improved well-being during the trial.

name: Sustainable Packaging Switch
description: Replace current packaging with recyclable materials across product lines.
primary_benefit: The company can reduce packaging waste and strengthen its environmental reputation.
